data.long_meaning: In Greek, Bobina means 'God is my strength'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'bous', which means 'ox' or 'strength', and 'ina', which means 'in' or 'God'. The name Bobina carries the meaning “God is my strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
